name: text-reveal
title: Text Reveal
description: Fade in text as you scroll down the page.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TextReveal } from '@/components/ui/text-reveal'
</script>

<template>
  <TextReveal text="Vue Magic UI will change the way you design." />
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: The text to reveal, split on spaces. When omitted, the plain-text content of the default slot is used (Magic UI's `children`).

props.name: class
props.description: Classes for the tall scroll section (default height `200vh`; the sticky text panel is half of it).

props.name: container
props.description: The scrolling element to track. Defaults to the page. Vue addition: set it when TextReveal sits inside its own `overflow-y-auto` box.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to reveal, used when the `text` prop is not set.
